Asset inspection, not a replacement combat animation. This repeatable demonstration uses a 60 Hz clock. It exposes shape, depth and breakup without changing hit frames or character poses. Save a draft and open the real fight to judge socket attachment, sword motion and camera readability.

What gets changed?Beam width, white channels and helical ribs use the production beam meshes. Signature silhouette, thickness, core and ink width use the same extruded geometry as projectiles, charge motifs and capture shards. Signature colors also tint the fighter’s projectile/binding body and ground-impact motif. Beam white/ink channels and Tala chi keep their authored colors. The game reads saved presets only with ?vfxPreview=1. Normal play keeps the committed defaults. Neither simulation nor rig data is changed.
